patch_description: Building on the hierarchical, symmetry-based design, this version increases expressivity by relocating the ring entanglement to a parameterized CRX ring and introducing per-edge CRY hub entanglement gates with distinct parameters. This adds targeted, edge-specific rotation angles to center-to-edge connections while preserving symmetry-driven parameter sharing for the pre/post RZ and center/edge/corner groups. The changes aim to improve validation/generalization while keeping the overall architecture compatible with the fixed training loop, data encoding, and data-uploading scheme. The rest of the pipeline (data, feature map, uploads, repeats, and Adam training) remains unchanged.
